zh: 字符可以从任意位置挑、任意重排，所以位置和顺序都不重要，只有每种字母的数量重要。
取 q 次目标词，t 中每种字母都要提供 q 倍的需求量，因此 q 不能超过 s 中该字母个数除以 t 中需求量（向下取整）；这些上界中的最小值就能达到。
分别统计 s 和 t 的 26 个字母频次；对 t 中出现的每个字母计算 s 中个数整除 t 中个数，取最小值输出。
en: Characters can be picked from anywhere and rearranged freely, so positions and order do not matter; only the count of each letter does.

Taking the target q times requires q times the demand of every letter in t, so q cannot exceed the count of that letter in s divided by its demand in t, rounded down; the minimum of these bounds is achievable.
Count the 26 letters of s and of t; for each letter that appears in t, divide its count in s by its count in t, rounding down, and print the minimum.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count the characters of s and t separately. The answer is the minimum, over every character that appears in t, of how many times it can be supplied, countS//countT.

## Proof of correctness

Taking q copies requires q times the demand of every target letter, so each frequency ratio is an upper bound. If q does not exceed any bound, every letter has enough copies to distribute among the q copies, and arbitrary rearrangement lets each copy form the target independently, so the minimum bound is exactly achievable.

## Complexity

Time O(|s|+|t|), auxiliary space O(26).
